chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. Amer narrated to us from al-Mu'alla b. Muhammad al-Basri from Ja'far b. Sulayman from Abdullah b. al-Hakam from his father from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Surely, Ali is my deputy and my vicegerent. His wife, Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, is my daughter. al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, are my two sons. Whoever aligns with them has aligned with me, and whoever opposes them has opposed me, and whoever defies them has defied me, and whoever is neglectful of them has been neglectful of me, and whoever is good to them has been good to me. May Allah connect with whoever connects with them, and cut off whoever cuts them off, and support whoever aids them, and assist whoever assists them, and cause failure to whoever fails them. O Allah, each of Your prophets and Your messengers had a heavyweight and a household. So, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn are my household and my heavyweight; so remove uncleanliness from them and purify them with a thorough purification.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn being his household and heavyweight?
ai.summary: This comprehensive hadith from Ibn Abbas records the Prophet's (s) declaration of the status of his family: Ali as his deputy, Fatima as Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn as Masters of the Youth of Paradise. The Prophet equates treatment of them to treatment of himself, invokes divine support for their allies and divine abandonment of their opponents, and prays for their purification using the words of Quran 33:33. The comparison with other prophets' families establishes a parallel between his household and the households granted to previous prophets.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from al-Mu`alla b. Muhammad al-Basri rom Ja`far b. Sulayman from `Abdullah b. al-Hakam from his father from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Prophet (s) said:

Surely, `Ali is my deputy and my vicegerent. His wife, Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, is my daughter. Al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, are my two sons. Whoever aligns with them has aligned with me, and whoever opposes them has opposed me, and whoever defies them has defied me, and whoever is neglectful of them is neglectful of me, and whoever is good to them is good to me. Allah will connect with whoever connects with them, and He will cut off whoever cuts them off, and He will support whoever aids them, and He will cause failure to whoever fails them. O Allah! Each of Your prophets and Your messengers had a heavyweight and a family. So, `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn are my family and my heavyweight; so, remove all uncleanliness from them, and purify them with a thorough purification.
